build_VoteNet_model: build a VoteNet 3D object detector with a backbone network and bounding box head
run_forward_train_VoteNet: run the VoteNet forward training pass with point cloud data and ground truth 3D boxes
test_VoteNet_simple_test: test the VoteNet model on point cloud data and return predicted 3D bounding boxes
test_VoteNet_aug_test: test the VoteNet model with augmentation by merging augmented 3D bounding box predictions
review_VoteNet_bbox_head: review the VoteNet bounding box head loss computation and prediction generation logic
